purpose: Convert a cold visitor: the product promise, the trial CTA, the proof stack.
maxWordsBasis: word-counted directly from the real strings in src/components/Hero.jsx
geometry: section height 3151px @1280; inner pt-[10.2em]; hero screenshot wrapper w-[81.25em]

scrollProgressRange.note: Leaf per-leaf ranges live in src/lib/leaves.js `track.start`/`track.end`.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: recognition lines forced to scaleX(1); hearts forced to opacity 1; leaves held at rotate-only transform
motion.composition: 4 marketing-drift-leaf + 8 marketing-scroll-leaf; plus 2 scaleX line draws and 2 opacity reveals
motion.scrollTrackElement: the hero screenshot wrapper, exposed via a ref and data-scroll-track="hero"
motion.additionalStaticLeaves: the 2 testimonial cards each carry 6 STATIC QUOTE_LEAVES — never animate them

responsive.max-wf-tablet: hero frame 80em; avatar pill 2 repositions; testimonial pair wraps
responsive.max-wf-phone: avatar pill 1 becomes static above the h1, pill 2 is display:none; the whole hero-overlay layer rescales via text-[0.6em] on the track wrapper
responsive.max-wf-mini: h1 drops to 3.9em; hero frame w-auto; screenshot wrapper 56em
responsive.note: The overlay lines and hearts MUST stay children of the track wrapper — max-wf-phone:text-[0.6em] on that div is what rescales the whole layer.

quirk: The h1 contains two inline <span>s carrying mr-[2.25em] / ml-[2.25em] to clear the avatar pills. Keep them.
